vectors.name: formats-toml/escapes/control-character-hex-digits-are-lowercase
vectors.comment: C-14: the TOML writer spells U+001F as `\u001f`, lowercase. The key contains a space so that every writer must quote it: TOML writer layout beyond that (bare versus quoted keys where either is legal) is not what the vector pins.

vectors.name: formats-toml/escapes/vertical-tab-hex-digit-is-lowercase
vectors.comment: C-14: U+000B is `\u000b`, lowercase `b`. The key is quoted for the reason given on the vector above.
